note: The consent keys (repo_roots, relaunch_auto, relaunch_allow) come from the account's ~/.claude/settings.json, the home of the user database (getpwuid), not $HOME. This case runs without the runner's consent seam (consent_home account), so its fresh HOME is not the account home: a settings file under HOME that accepts the repository, turns relaunch on and allows every command grants nothing. Each key takes its safe value with the note '<key>: HOME is not the account home, safe value used' and one config_note {note: home-not-account} row; with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR naming HOME/.claude the note names CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. The account's own settings file is not read for these keys here, so the result does not depend on it

steps.name: a settings file under a HOME that is not the account home grants no consent

stdout_has: ^note: repo_roots: HOME is not the account home, safe value used$
^note: relaunch_auto: HOME is not the account home, safe value used$
^note: relaunch_allow: HOME is not the account home, safe value used$

steps.name: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR naming that HOME's .claude grants none either

stdout_has: ^note: repo_roots: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is not ~/\.claude, safe value used$
